items.text: This week, let's pray for unity, peace, and restoration in our homes.
items.verse: But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord.

items.text: Let's bring before God those who suffer in their bodies: may He visit them and raise them up.
items.verse: The prayer of faith will save the sick, and the Lord will raise him up.

items.text: Let's pray for those seeking employment and for God's provision over every household.
items.verse: My God will supply all your needs according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

items.text: Let's ask God to heal inner wounds and comfort those who are mourning.
items.verse: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

items.text: Let's intercede for the new generation: may they encounter Jesus and walk in His ways.
items.verse: Train up a child in the way he should go.

items.text: Let's pray for peace where there is war, and for peacemakers.
items.verse: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.

items.text: Let's ask God to revive hearts and touch those who don't yet know Him.
items.verse: Restore us again, O God of our salvation... will You not revive us again?

items.text: Let's pray for one another so that we hold firm and keep faith in trials.
items.verse: Those who trust in the Lord will renew their strength.
